documents.title: Introduction to PRIVEX Search Engine
documents.body: PRIVEX is an independent, privacy-first search engine built from scratch in Go. It implements an inverted index with BM25 ranking, positional postings, and two-plane architecture decoupling ingestion from query serving.

documents.title: BM25 and BM25F Ranking Explained
documents.body: Okapi BM25 is a non-linear term saturation ranking algorithm based on the Robertson-Spärck Jones probabilistic retrieval model. BM25F extends this by weighting multiple fields such as title, headings, and body text before saturation.

documents.title: Privacy and Security Architecture
documents.body: PRIVEX guarantees that user query strings are never written to access logs. Outbound search result clicks use direct links with rel noopener noreferrer to eliminate Referer leaks, and third-party trackers or external AI APIs are strictly excluded.

documents.title: Immutable On-Disk Segment Storage
documents.body: The serving plane queries immutable on-disk index segments without locks. Segments use delta encoding and varint compression for DocIDs, and background compaction periodically merges segments to purge tombstoned documents.

documents.title: Polite Web Crawler and Frontier
documents.body: The crawler frontier maintains per-host queues with polite rate limiting and honors robots.txt directives. Built-in SSRF guards resolve DNS to block loopback, private, and cloud metadata IP ranges on every request and redirect.
